Invest, spend, and save.
Earn interest on your money. Get your subscription free card to spend and earn 1 % Saveback. Invest easily and safely with just 1 €.

Earn while you spend
- Activate 2.5 % interest on your cash balance, paid out monthly.
- No monthly subscription fee. Unlimited free ATM withdrawals worldwide on amounts over 100 €.
- Earn 1 % "Saveback" on your eligible card spending into your Savings Plans. You can earn Saveback on up to 1,500 € of monthly spending. To qualify, invest at least 50 € per month in Savings Plans.
- Round up your card payments and invest the spare change with the Round-up feature.

Save now for later
- Invest with just 1 € in stocks, ETFs, crypto and Private Markets. No hidden fees.
- Set up recurring Savings Plans without any fees from Trade Republic to build long term wealth.
- Diversify your investments with new portfolios, such as Private Markets, Fixed Income, and Crypto Wallets.

Trusted by millions
- Over 10 million customers and 150 billion € in assets across 18 European countries.
- A fully licensed German bank regulated by BaFin and the Bundesbank.
- Orders executed at the Best Price across all relevant exchanges against Trade Republic.
- Talk to us anytime via live chat or phone. Speak directly with our team of experts.

We are on a mission to empower everyone to create wealth with easy, safe and free access to the financial system.

Investments involve risks. Investments in cryptocurrencies are highly volatile and carry a risk of total loss. Selling bonds before maturity may involve market price risks. Past performance is not a guarantee of future results. Receive interest from partner banks. Saveback terms and conditions apply. Values are illustrative. 3% p.a. offer for new customers only. T&Cs apply.

Note: Not all services mentioned above are available in every market. The scope and availability of our offerings — including stocks, ETFs, Savings Plans, Crypto, Fixed Income, Private Markets and derivatives — may vary by country. For more information, please visit our website.


Brunnenstr. 19-21 
10119 Berlin, Germany
